title: Redefining what talent acquisition consulting can deliver.
summary: Discover how KellyOCG redefines talent acquisition consulting by offering practical, innovative solutions and trusted expertise to tackle today's workforce challenges.
body_markdown:
The talent acquisition (TA) landscape has changed beyond recognition.[Skills shortages](https://www.kellyocg.com/insights/a-skilled-trades-talent-shortage-clouds-industry-growth/) , shifting workforce expectations,[rapid technological disruption](https://www.kellyocg.com/insights/thanks-to-ai-employers-are-rethinking-tasks-not-just-job-definitions/) , and[increasing pressure to do more with less](https://www.kellyocg.com/insights/the-quiet-reset-global-talent-strategy-in-an-uncertain-economy/) have created the perfect storm for HR and TA leaders. Many organisations I speak with are not just looking for a recruitment provider: They’re looking for a strategic partner who has lived through the same challenges and knows how to solve them.


##


Advisory services from KellyOCG® deliver on this need. Built on practical, expert-led talent advice that goes beyond strategy to deliver lasting impact, our services are delivered by people who have done the work themselves.


##


## **What makes advisory services from KellyOCG different?**


##


There’s no shortage of consultants willing to produce a glossy report and hand it over. What’s rarer is a partner who stays engaged through implementation and owns the outcome alongside you, not just the recommendation. That’s the philosophy behind our advisory offering.


### **We bring three elements that set us apart:**


- **Practical solutions aligned to your goals.** We don’t deal in theoretical frameworks. We design actionable strategies that fit your organisation's specific context and deliver measurable outcomes.


- **Innovative approaches for a competitive edge.** We leverage advanced talent insights, proven technology, and leading-edge practices to help you stay ahead in a rapidly changing market.


- **Trusted expertise, proven impact.** Kelly® brings 80 years of workforce experience. With 1,000+ RPO professionals operating across 70+ countries in 30+ languages, we have the depth and breadth to support organisations at every scale.


## **A comprehensive suite of recruitment advisory services.**


##


Our advisory offering covers the full spectrum of workforce challenges. Our 12 service areas have been designed to address the most common (and most complex) problems TA leaders face today:


- **Employer value proposition (EVP) and branding.** Define and market your unique employer brand to attract and retain the talent you need. This includes current state diagnostics, EVP development and messaging, marketing collateral creation, and recruitment marketing strategy.
- **Candidate experience.** Transform your candidate journey to ensure a seamless, engaging, and authentic experience from application through onboarding.


- **Talent technology and digital optimisation.** Elevate your talent technology ecosystem for greater efficiency, integration, automation, and security.


- **Data analytics.** Leverage robust data and advanced analytics to drive smarter talent decisions and workforce planning.


- **Change management, risk mitigation, and transformation enablement.** Accelerate and sustain talent transformation through effective stakeholder alignment, communication, and continuous improvement.


- **Talent market intelligence and insights.** Equip your organisation with actionable market intelligence — including talent supply/demand analytics, compensation benchmarking, location strategy, and competitor hiring intelligence — to inform competitive workforce strategies.


- **Process design and optimisation.** Redesign and streamline your end-to-end recruitment processes to maximise speed, quality, and consistency.


- **Talent acquisition organisational design.** Align your TA organisation, roles, and operating models to meet current and future business needs.


- **Recruitment spend diagnostic.** Identify cost drivers and uncover savings opportunities across your entire recruitment spend portfolio.


- **TA equity and inclusion consulting.** Empower your organisation to achieve measurable progress in inclusive talent acquisition that drives a sense of belonging.


- **Workforce planning.** Build agile, data-driven workforce plans to anticipate and meet evolving talent demands.


- **Workforce development.** Enable business growth by recruiting, onboarding, training, and managing for both immediate and long-term success.


Curious how your TA function measures up?


[Take our TA Quality Quiz](https://taexcellence.kellyocg.com/?utm_source=talent-unbound-web&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=2026_02_ocg_b2b_leadgen_talent-acquisition-quality-quiz&utm_content=taexcellence_assessment) and get a scorecard with your strengths and opportunities for improvement.


## **Expertise that meets you where you are.**


Our advisory offering isn’t a one-size-fits-all programme. Each engagement is scoped to the specific challenge a client is facing, at the moment they’re facing it. We’re typically brought in at key moments of change, whether that’s opening a new location, entering a new sector, launching a new product or service, tackling talent shortages, or accelerating headcount growth. But we’re just as valuable when the trajectory is less certain. Organisations turn to us when restructuring, resetting processes, or navigating complexity — whenever sharper thinking and the right people can make a measurable difference.


These are moments when you need advisors who have been there before.


## From strategy to outcomes: a real-world example.


A recent illustration of our advisory services in action comes from a major health insurance company that wanted to build its technology workforce in Ireland. The challenge was significant: high demand for tech skills in a competitive market, virtually no local brand visibility, and the need to move quickly.


KellyOCG designed and delivered a 12-month programme of hiring events targeting local tech talent. A dedicated sourcing strategist was assigned to lead the effort, working in close partnership with the client's TA and talent marketing teams. We built a GDPR-compliant tracking system integrated with their CRM, launched pre-event marketing campaigns across social media and traditional advertising, and executed post-event nurture campaigns to keep candidates engaged.


**The results speak for themselves:**


- Seven hiring events delivered (five in-person, two virtual) over 12 months


- 2,000+ registrations


- 1,250+ attendees


- 500+ recruiter screening interviews conducted


- 74 hires made directly from event registrants


## The talent acquisition partner you’ve been looking for.


The world doesn’t need more consulting reports. It needs more partners who are willing to roll up their sleeves and make change happen alongside you. That’s what our advisory offering is built to do — and it’s backed by a global network of 1,000+ KellyOCG professionals with real-world HR/TA experience across every major market.


If your organisation is navigating a talent challenge — whether it is brand recognition, process inefficiency, technology adoption, workforce planning, or something in between — we welcome a conversation.
